# exec sh -c {a | b}
puts {exec sh -c {a | b}}
set doc {exec bash -c {ls | wc -l}}
puts "exec sh -c ls"
set pipe [open "|sh -c {a | b}"]
exec -ignorestderr sh -c {a | b}
exec $shell -c {a | b}
exec [auto_execok sh] -c {a | b}
exec sh $flag {a | b}
exec sh script.sh {a | b}
exec ssh -c aes128-ctr host
